caption:
Planning a rishta step by step brings calm to the search.

At RishtaPatra, our hero line guides each stage: "Make your biodata. Match your kundali. Find your rishta."

We offer three products designed to support your family:
• Biodata maker — create an A4 biodata with ease.
• Janam Kundali (free) — run birth charts directly in your browser.
• Rishta Connect (matchmaking) — explore meaningful matches, where cards feature a 36-point Guna Milan score such as "Guna Milan 22.5/36".

Note: Kundali calculations are indicative; consult your pandit.

Begin your journey at rishtapatra.com
